ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 65% high-intensity (off-white/yellow) pixels to 35% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity contiguous regions on the lateral lobes. Low-intensity (black) pigmentation is concentrated around the median notch, extending horizontally along the trailing edges. Distinct low-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) intersect the high-intensity regions on both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression; interior pixel angle approximately 40-45 degrees; vertical depth relative to the highest lobe point is approximately 30% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrations with variable frequency; high-amplitude protrusions (nodules) concentrated at the distal tips; moderate pixel-amplitude variations along the outer trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward trajectory originating from the median notch and sweeping toward high-elevation distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, multi-tonal circular nodules (barnacle colonization) localized exclusively at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent, nearly vertical, high-contrast linear pixel disruptions on the left lobe; multiple fainter, curved linear tracks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake-mark scarring on both lobes; heavy nodular encrustation at the tips; small circular high-contrast spots on the mid-right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dual-parallel vertical scar pattern on the mid-left lobe ventral surface.
